sentences.text: Task 1. You and one of the group members, Aaron, are discussing your plans for the project.
Listen to the conversation and fill in the information sheet below.
Two have been done for you as examples.
You now have 30 seconds to study the note headings.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
Hi, Sam. How’s it going?
Yeah, OK, thanks.
I was thinking, we should maybe start, you know, thinking about things about this project.
I mean, like what our time limit is, how we’re going to share the work.
Or what resources we can use Exactly.
Hold on. I’ll take some notes so we can show George and Lucy later on.
Fine. We need to have an action plan to present to Mr Johnson next week.
Yeah. So, today is the 23rd of January and we’re meeting Mr.
Johnson next, when?
Monday, that’s, the 30th of January.
Yeah. Monday The 30th, I think it is.
The deadline for the project’s the 10th of February.
So we’ve got 3 weeks to do it.
Yeah. There’s a lot to do before the 10th.
I don't know.
I think we should start with the information collection.
The what? You know, the information collection.
Collecting all the information and stuff for the introduction the background What?
What? From the Internet or?
Yeah. I think the Internet’s the obvious place to start.
You could just do a google search.
Mind you we’d have to limit ourselves a bit.
There’s just going to be too much stuff.
Yeah, true. It’s meant to be on Hong Kong.
there’ll be enough if we just search Hong Kong websites I’m sure.
OK, so how long do you think we should spend on that?
On Hong Kong websites.
sites Maybe a day, maybe a bit longer.
Yeah. OK, let’s say a day and a half.
I’ll note that down I can do that.
Good. Right. The other thing we should be doing is, going to the library.
Yeah. How about we go together to the school library sometime next week.
Yeah, all right How about next Tuesday after school?
Oh, I can’t next Tuesday, I’ve got that choir practice.
Oh. Yeah. Well but you could maybe take George.
Or Lucy maybe.
Yeah, what I was thinking was, you know how George lives really near the Central Library?
Yeah. Well, he could go there to Central Library at the weekend.
No problem. And that would take him what for hours or something like that.
Yeah good idea.
We can put down four hours for George in the Central Library but what’s that got to do with the school library?
Well, George would be the best person to come with me because he’d know what he’s found at the Central Library already.
Oh, OK. What?
Instead of me?
Yeah, exactly. Instead of you on Tuesday.
Then you can go to your choir practice.
I’ll let George know.
There isn’t much in there so I’ll write two hours in the plan then.
Fine. Is that it then?
No, We’re going to need more than that.
Like what? Well, I was thinking.
Isn’t Lucy’s father a doctor?
Yeah. I think so.
Yeah. Well, she could interview him.
Her father I mean.
Couldn’t she? Yeah, I suppose she could.
That’s really a good idea actually.
Yeah I know.
That’s much better than just the usual stuff off the internet.
It could be really interesting to hear what Lucy’s father says.
Yeah. That’s what I was thinking.
Right, let me write it down before we forget.
Oh. You’d better write Dr.
Lam in the action Plan.
It would look a bit strange to write Lucy’s father Yeah, it would have bit.
How do you spell that L -A -M?
Yeah. Should only take her half an hour.
Yeah. Not too long.
Right. So is that us done?
No, we still to decide who does what.
I mean the writing.
Who’s going to write what Oh yeah.
Well, maybe I can write the introduction and background.
I mean, I’ll have done all the collecting of the information and stuff by then, so OK, but you can’t just choose the easiest bit yourself!
What? I mean, the results section.
That’s much more work and I can’t finish it on my own!
OK OK. well, we can do the results part together, if you like.
You and me.
OK? Yeah, But what about George and Lucy?
Well, we can get them to do the conclusions and recommendations.
That should keep them busy.
Fine. I think we should put here in the action plan, How long to give us to do the write up.
Hmm. Let’s put ten days.
OK. Right That looks like an action plan Yep.
